statements.name: main:intro
statements.text:
\label{main:intro}
There is an absolute integer $K_0$ such that, for every integer
$k\ge K_0$ and every integer $r\ge2$,
\[
 W_r(k)>k^{c k\lfloor\log_2r\rfloor},
 \qquad c=10^{-5}.
\]
